_about: my-win-kit settings shared by every PC. Edited by hand in the repo; every PC reads it from GitHub at start-up (the menu only shows it). autoInstallPwsh: the loader installs PowerShell 7 + Windows Terminal without asking. elevateAtStart: the loader asks for administrator rights once at start (one UAC prompt), so no installer asks again. A PC can override both in Settings (stored locally).
